ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: dr_libs (David Reid): the single file MP3 and FLAC decoders dr_mp3 and dr_flac
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: dr_mp3.h 0.7.4 and dr_flac.h 0.13.4 from one commit of dr_libs, see dependencies/README.txt. Header only: exactly one source file of a product defines DR_MP3_IMPLEMENTATION and DR_FLAC_IMPLEMENTATION before including the header to compile the implementation.
